chunk.content: Rastrelliger kanagurta, one of the Rastrelliger mackerels sold as gembolo in West Sumatra, was chosen for a fish snack study because it tastes good and is cheap.
chunk.source_quote: it taste good and tasty, and the price are cheap

source.title: Pemanfaatan Daging dan Tulang Ikan Kembung (Rastrelliger kanagurta) dalam Pembuatan Camilan Stik (Jurnal Teknologi Hasil Pertanian, doi:10.20961/jthp.v10i1.17492)
